pages.text: Cultivated Farmland is prepared soil for water-loving crops such as rice.$(br2)It starts as normal farmland, then is worked with a Cultivator.
Craft a Cultivator, then use it on farmland to convert the block.
Cultivated Farmland needs nearby water before rice can be planted. It will flood naturally when water is close enough.$(br2)You can also use a water bucket on it to flood it immediately.
Once you see that there is a layer of water on top of the farmland, plant your crops that require cultivated farmland.$(br2)Rice grows at about the same rate as wheat.
